title: Private Guided Tour in San Francisco
includes: All sites included in the program
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
A Grand Tour of San Francisco, a unique experience with a walk on the Golden Gate Bridge! Discover the most beautiful residential areas where Victorian houses succeed with the most famous of them: Painted Ladies. Passage through the Haight & Ashbury neighborhood where you enter the history and dream of the hippie movement. 
Experienced French-speaking, local and independent professional guide. 
Possibility to make other visits according to your choice
